Type: sofa
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Laurel Rounded Loveseat Sofa Settee Couch, 57.1"W, Sand
Colors: Linen
Materials: linen/viscose blend
57.1”W x 30.7”D x 31.9”H Sturdy hardwood frame with linen/viscose blend upholstery Elegant, vintage style with highly durable fabric for easy care and long life Curl up with a good book on this sleek rounded vintage loveseat. The exposed rustic wood frame and neutral linen-like upholstery allow it to blend with any décor while the tufted back and removable foam cushion promise good looks and durability. No assembly required. Wipe with a soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
